At noon Nora was in the office. Nora had the archive key at noon.

At noon Nora was not in the office. Nora did not have the archive key at noon.

Nora said, "I was in the office all day. I had the archive key."

Nora remembered leaving the scarf on the chair.

On Monday Claire was in Paris.

On Tuesday Claire was in Madrid.

Where was the key?
